digest.component_or_area: backend-neutrality test gate and inbound field mapper location
propositions: inbound_fields.py must remain at the package root to allow both Jira adapters to share it while preserving the J7 sibling-adapter seal that forbids direct jira<->jira_datacenter imports
moving inbound_fields.py to adapters/jira/ would violate the J7 contract by creating a jira_datacenter->jira sibling import
moving inbound_fields.py to adapters/jira_family/ would violate the mirror rule because root-core consumers (inbound_differ.py, peer_state.py) cannot import that layer
the module's by-path load of adapters/jira/adf.py cannot be routed through jira_family/ without laundering the AST contract gate
the backend-neutrality sweep exemption must be rewritten to document the permanent J7 architectural cost rather than describe it as temporary relocation debt
